title: Asia Chip & AI Stocks Swing (SK Hynix, SoftBank, Nikkei, Nvidia vs TSMC)
summary: Gotrade News - Asia's chip and AI trade swung higher on Monday (October 5), as Japan's Nikkei 225 jumped 2.4% to 69,946.86 on softer US jobs data, while
body_markdown:
Yahoo Finance reported that the stock is up more than 60% year to date, driven by AI demand, as TSMC expands US manufacturing for clients including Apple, Nvidia and AMD. Nvidia does not produce its own chips at scale, so TSMC's capacity plans remain a direct read-through for the AI chip supply chain.


## Intel (INTC) Slips as Terafab Looks at TSMC


The Terafab news weighed on[Intel (INTC)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/intc/) , which joined the venture in April and declined more than 2%, as reported by Yahoo Finance. Terafab is Musk's plan to build a major chip facility serving Tesla, SpaceX and xAI, so any role for TSMC raises questions about how the work would be shared.


## SK Hynix Trapped Below Its SMA20 at 1,813,000 Won


In Seoul, SK Hynix traded at 1,813,000 won, below its 20-day simple moving average of 1,822,250 won, according to an[Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/sk-hynix-trapped-below-sma20-in-tight-range-live-levels-93CH-4933195) technical update. The report described the setup as a "range consolidation, not yet resolved," with support from the 50-day average at 1,770,000 won and the 200-day average sitting higher at 1,955,505 won.


Investing.com added that the MACD "has crossed negative, tilting short-term risk to the downside until reversed," and that volatility is compressed, with the average true range at 2.4% of price.
